entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac, I'm calling about the VeloBand GPS tracker I bought. The pulse reader is completely inaccurate.
I see. I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble with it. To make sure I understand, is it a technical fault with the device, or is it more of a preference issue with how it displays the data?
It's definitely a fault. It's telling me my heart rate is 180 when I'm just sitting on the couch. The pulse tracking feature is basically garbage.

I understand your frustration. That certainly doesn't sound right. I can transfer you over to our technical support team. They have a few troubleshooting steps that can usually resolve sensor inaccuracies.

I appreciate that, but I really don't have time to go through a bunch of tech support steps. Honestly, I'm not interested in a replacement either. I just want money back for it. I'd like to get a refund.
I see. You're just looking to return the item. Let me pull up your account and check the policy for you. One moment please... Okay, I see you received the VeloBand about 36 days ago, correct?
Alright. Well, according to our policy, all items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. Since you're well within that timeframe, I can absolutely process that return for you.
Oh, really? That's perfect. I was worried it would be a bigger issue. Thank you for making that so simple.

Of course. I've just sent a prepaid return label to the email we have on file. Just package the VeloBand in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once we receive it, you'll see the refund credited to your original payment method in about 3-5 business days. Can I help with anything else?
No, that's everything. Thanks for your help, Isaac.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
